title: Ink‐Extrusion 3D Printing and Silicide Coating of HfNbTaTiZr Refractory High‐Entropy Alloy for Extreme Temperature Applications

recollection.intervention: Ink-extrusion 3D printing followed by silicide coating
recollection.structure: 3D-printed high-entropy alloy with a silicide-coated surface
recollection.mechanism: Formation of a protective silicide layer to enhance high-temperature performance
recollection.results: Likely improved thermal stability and oxidation resistance for extreme temperature applications

score.note: The recollection largely restates the title. It identifies ink-extrusion printing and silicide coating but omits hydrogen de-binding and 1400°C/18 h vacuum sintering. It gives no phase, hydride-decomposition, oxygen-strengthening, quenching, or self-healing oxide-fill details, and provides none of the reported quantitative results.
